_comment: Positive render_map fixture: a 2-layer inline map (h3 dwell density + a scatterplot of the sites inside it). Doubles as the worked example for the render_map spec contract. Asserted valid by fleet_tools/user/verify_map_spec.mts; the negative counterparts live in that harness. Queries read the neutral FLEET_APP contract, bind only context.* params, and simplify nothing because neither layer carries line or polygon geometry. It carries NO legend on purpose: the client derives one from each layer's colours, so an authored key could only contradict the map - name a layer with legendLabel instead.
title: Dwell density and served sites
emptyMessage: No dwell sessions for the active region and date range.

data.query: SELECT H3_CELL AS h3_cell, ROUND(SUM(DWELL_MINUTES)) AS dwell_minutes FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DWELL_ENRICHED WHERE REGION = :region GROUP BY H3_CELL ORDER BY dwell_minutes DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT SITE_NAME AS site_name, SITE_LON AS site_lon, SITE_LAT AS site_lat, COUNT(*) AS visits FROM FLEET_APP.DWELL.VW_DWELL_ENRICHED WHERE REGION = :region AND SITE_LON IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SITE_NAME, SITE_LON, SITE_LAT ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 200
